text: Implemented and verified P1.1. Added DesignSchema with closed StructuralColumnOrigin algebra (event, sampled, intercept, drift, nuisance, baseline, explicit Legacy), typed CellKey factor/LevelId assignments, BasisElementRef identity/role, RunScope, RowLayout from SamplingFrame, structured DesignAudit, and deterministic cross-platform DesignFingerprint canonical encoding. EventModel and BaselineModel builds now attach canonical schemas; ConvolvedTerm records structural cells/modulators; formula diagnostics recompute the schema audit/fingerprint instead of leaving a stale copy. DesignColmap now renders compatibility metadata from structural origins, with only an explicitly named legacy label fallback; legacy constructors remain supported. Added JVM/JS schema invariants, baseline/event provenance, fingerprint, and typed-error tests. Evidence: git diff --check; designJVM/test 161 passed; designJS/test 161 passed; modelJVM/test 16 passed; modelJS/test 16 passed; full tools/ci/first-level-gate.sh passed all 12 JVM/JS gates (scenario-testkit 3/3, hrf 202/202, hrf laws 77/77, design 161/161, model 16/16, fit 154 JVM and 146 JS). No remote CI or live external regeneration claim.
